appName.context: The app's name, shown on the sign-in screen and at the top of the side navigation on a laptop.

today.context: Day heading in lists and the date picker: the current day.

yesterday.context: Day heading in lists and the date picker: the day before today.

back.context: Generic button: go to the previous step (tour, multi-step forms).

next.context: Generic button: go to the next step (tour, multi-step forms).

add.context: Generic accessible label of a '+' button that adds the typed item (a person, a line).

perDay.context: Short label of a dashed reference line on bar charts: the limit per day. Very short.

spent.context: Chart tooltip row label: the amount spent that day or month.

amountOver.context: Short status next to a total: {amount} (with currency) over the limit.

amountLeft.context: Short status next to a total: {amount} (with currency) still available.

close.context: Generic accessible label of a close (×) button.

color.context: Label above the colour swatches (category, goal, account, trip).

notDeleted.context: Generic error after a failed delete; {error} is technical.

choose.context: Placeholder of a dropdown with nothing picked.

backToBudget.context: Accessible label of the back arrow on pages opened from the Budget tab.

loading.context: Accessible label of a loading placeholder.
